narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the fascinating world of real numbers! In this video, we'll explore what real numbers are, why they're so fundamental to mathematics, and how they connect to the number line. We'll also touch upon their essential properties. By the end, you'll have a solid understanding of this core concept, which is crucial for all higher mathematics. Let's dive in!
